note: Analyst reading of the news, written from logged events. Not data. The weekly agent replaces it every week. The log is a sample: it ends with the Oct 12, 2026 launch (#2076) and many launches are missing.
headline: North Korea has launched or provoked five times since Sep 12: ballistic missiles on Sep 12 (#2072) and Sep 20 (#2073), mine blasts at the DMZ that wounded three South Korean soldiers on Sep 21 (#2074), a hypersonic missile on Oct 3 (#2075) and multiple ballistic missiles on Oct 12 (#2076).

In August the US scaled down Ulchi Freedom Shield after Trump cited his relationship with Kim (#2068). On Aug 19 Trump said he will meet Kim, and Kim Yo Jong denied any communication (#2069). About 10 short-range missiles were fired the next day (#2070).
Freedom Edge 26, the trilateral exercise, began Sep 7 (#2071). The last Treasury sanctions round in the log is Mar 12, 2026 (#2066).
Hold-week caveat for option A: hold weeks are weeks since Jan 20, 2025 with no logged US move. The log is a sample, so a quiet-looking week may only be an unlogged one.
